description: Comprehensive drug catalog with market baseline prices.

weed.message: You spark up a blunt. The chronic soothes your wounds. Healed 3 HP.

crack.message: You smoke the rock. You feel invincible, but your heart hammers painfully!

coke.message: You rail a line. Energy surges through your veins, but your nose bleeds slightly. Took 3 damage!

ice.message: You smoke the crystal. Your mind races at impossible speeds. Took 8 damage from the crash coming!

percs.message: Pain fades away as the percs kick in. Healed 10 HP.

pixie_dust.message: You inhale the synthetic dust. Euphoria overwhelms you, but reality distorts. Took 4 damage!

lean.message: Everything slows down... you feel heavy and relaxed. Healed 5 HP.

shrooms.message: The psilocybin takes hold. Colors explode and time dissolves. Took 6 damage from the trip!

acid.message: LSD hits your bloodstream. The walls breathe and melt. Took 7 damage from sensory overload!

opium.message: You smoke the black resin. Warmth spreads through your body. Healed 8 HP.

crystal_blue.message: Sudden burst of intense energy and focus! But the crash will be brutal. Took 10 damage!

white_widow.message: This potent hybrid hits different. You feel both relaxed and energized. Healed 5 HP, took 2 damage from paranoia.

purple_haze.message: Jimi's favorite takes you on a trip. Your mind expands in purple waves. Took 5 damage!

fentanyl.message: You dance with death. Your breathing slows dangerously. Took 25 damage!

ketamine.message: You K-hole into another dimension. When you resurface, you feel refreshed but disoriented. Healed 7 HP, took 3 damage.

speed.message: Amphetamines course through your blood. You could run forever, but your heart is pounding. Took 6 damage!

blue_dream.message: California's finest gives you a dreamy, relaxed high. Healed 4 HP.

red_devil.message: This dangerous cocktail burns through your veins! Your senses sharpen to painful levels. Took 12 damage!

white_china.message: Pure heroin floods your system. Blissful numbness followed by crushing withdrawal. Took 15 damage!

mdma_crystals.message: Molly takes over. You love everyone and everything! Healed 6 HP, took 4 damage from dehydration.

moon_rocks.message: These dipped nugs hit like a meteor. Your brain becomes one with the cosmos. Took 9 damage!

blue_magic.message: Legendary purity H. You float on clouds of blue. Took 18 damage from the intensity!

grey_death.message: The lethal mix courses through you. This is a near-death experience. Took 30 damage!

super_lemon_haze.message: Citrus sativa power! You feel zesty, energetic, and ready to conquer. Healed 6 HP.
